description: This is the open code the Cook County Assessor's Office uses to estimate the market value of every single-family and small multi-family home in the county for property tax assessment. Written in R with the Tidymodels framework, it has used a county-wide LightGBM gradient boosting model since 2021, trained on arm's-length sales and parcel characteristics with location, proximity and time features. The README documents a seven-stage pipeline (ingest, train, assess, evaluate, interpret, finalise, export), the features used, how sales are filtered, and how condominiums are handled by a separate repository. Coverage: residential parcels in Cook County, Illinois, with a branch for each assessment year from 2021 to 2025. Access: public GitHub repository with reproducible pipeline and data retrieval steps; earlier CAMA code sits on GitLab. Licence: AGPL-3.0; free. Caveats: the model predicts assessed market value, not rebuild cost, and runs need the office's data from the open data portal or its own warehouse. Simulation uses are property value surfaces for loss and investment appraisal studies and a worked example of transparent mass appraisal. Related records: the Cook County Assessor open data.
